scope: Explicit Qwen packed Q4_K expert route execution, F32 activations and accumulation

findings.before: Qwen profile rejected topk-route; all scheduled every padded expert slot, topk-readback required CPU route observation.
findings.after: Explicit topk-route resolves GPU expert IDs for packed gate/up and down projections, combines routes without gathered expert slots or CPU route readback.

findings.finding: Shared expert branch still uses separate projections, scalar gate expansion and output combination; this extension does not fuse that branch.
Route-wise projection rereads expert weights for repeated routes; grouped/tiled prefill may be preferable. No prefill or decode speed promotion without separate measurements.
Native Pooled GPU decode-ahead requires flash attention; it cannot explain the existing F32-KV comparison. CPU encode-ahead is a separate mechanism.
Physical proof covers Node/Dawn Metal and Chromium/Metal. Vulkan, D3D12 and full 35B continuation are not qualified.
Several supplied audit source sizes, hashes, filenames and workload claims do not match the actual pinned snapshot. The proposed dispatch counts and guaranteed improvements are unverified.

acceptance.lintWarnings: vec3 appears only in invocation/workgroup builtins, not stored uniform or storage data.

limitations: Fixture router supplies logits in the MoE core check; model router projection and learned 35B tensors are not tested by that fixture
Only contiguous row-packed Q4_K expert banks with scalar F32 activations; unsupported formats fail, not fallback
No speed win, no model catalogue promotion, no default execution change
